description: This is a Java interface defining Data Access Object (DAO) methods for handling 'Group' entities within the 'sales manager' application. It extends a generic DAO interface and declares methods to retrieve groups by permissions, type, and IDs.

classes.name: GroupDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to 'Group' entities, extending a generic DAO and providing custom query methods.

methods.name: getGroupsListBypermissions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of `Group` objects filtered by a set of permission IDs.

methods.name: listGroup
methods.description: Returns a list of `Group` objects by specified `GroupType`.

methods.name: listGroupByIds
methods.description: Fetches a list of `Group` objects corresponding to a set of group IDs.
